metadata.principal_investigator: Dr. Donald M. Hassler (Southwest Research Institute)

1814.name: GLE72 / X8.2 Solar Super-Flare & Coronal Mass Ejection
1814.primary_radiation: Relativistic Solar Energetic Protons (>500 MeV) & Secondary Neutrons
1814.rad_anomaly: Detector B and E saturation spikes; highest surface GLE of Solar Cycle 24.
1814.scientific_citation: Hassler et al. 2018 (Earth and Space Science), Guo et al. 2018 (Astronomy & Astrophysics)

3108.name: Active Region 12824 M-Class Flare & Associated CME
3108.rad_anomaly: Elevated plastic detector dose rate over 36 hours.
3108.scientific_citation: MSL RAD Science Team Daily Operations Log (Sol 3108)

3770.name: AR 13256 Fast CME & Energetic Proton Enhancement
3770.rad_anomaly: Steep flux rise in Detector E; MAVEN detected upper-atmosphere ion loss surge.

4192.name: Solar Cycle 25 G5 Extreme Superstorm & Global Aurora
4192.primary_radiation: Extreme energetic protons and ion front; global Martian auroral glow
4192.rad_anomaly: Curiosity navigation cameras captured radiation 'snow'; RAD registered 8,100 uGy cumulative dose.
4192.scientific_citation: NASA Mars Exploration Program Press Release (June 2024), SwRI MSL RAD Alert

4210.name: Farside Mega-Flare Proton Wave
4210.primary_radiation: Solar energetic protons and coronal sheath shock wave
4210.rad_anomaly: Secondary peak from AR 13664 rotating onto the Mars-facing solar hemisphere.
4210.scientific_citation: NASA DONKI / MSL RAD Joint Assessment (May 2024)
